common.updateAvailable: A new version of the app is ready.

login.title: Sign in
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to set a new one.
login.httpsRequired: This page is opened over plain HTTP, so signing in will not work. Open the address that starts with https://.

welcome.title: Choose your password
welcome.hint: You signed in with a password someone else knows (for example, from the server log). Set your own to continue.

staff.title: Staff
staff.added: Account for {name} created. Give them the username and password.
staff.usernameHint: Used to sign in. 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

roleHint.owner: Sees everything, including money, and manages staff.
roleHint.mechanic: Works with vehicles, work orders and parts. No financial data.

staff.initialPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it later.
staff.selfHint: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
staff.resetPasswordHint: Use this if they forgot their password. They will be signed out on all devices.
staff.passwordSet: New password set. Give it to them in person.
staff.deactivateHint: A deactivated person cannot sign in. Their work history stays.

account.title: Account
account.passwordSignsOut: Other devices where you are signed in will be signed out.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.updateHint: To update, download the new docker-compose.yml on the server and run: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d

scanner.title: Scanner test
scanner.intro: Point the camera at a barcode or QR code to check that scanning works on this phone.

errors.insecure: The camera only works over HTTPS. Open the app through its https:// address.
errors.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
errors.noCamera: No camera found on this device.
errors.generic: Could not start the camera. Close other apps that use it and try again.
errors.engine: The scanner could not start in this browser. Try the latest Chrome or Safari.

errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
errors.server_unavailable: The server is not responding. Try again in a minute.
errors.internal: Server error. Try again; if it repeats, tell the owner.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner can do this.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.

too_many_attempts_wait.one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {count} minute.
too_many_attempts_wait.other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {count} minutes.

errors.invalid_username: Username must be 3–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.password_too_short: Password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.password_too_long: Password is too long. Use at most 256 characters.
errors.invalid_locale: Choose a language from the list.
errors.invalid_role: Choose a role from the list.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself.
errors.passwords_do_not_match: The new passwords do not match.
errors.vin_taken: A vehicle with this VIN already exists.
errors.frame_number_taken: A vehicle with this frame number already exists.
errors.vehicle_identifier_required: Enter a plate, VIN or frame number.
errors.invalid_vin: VIN must be 11–17 letters and digits (no I, O or Q).
errors.invalid_frame_number: Frame number: 5–24 Latin letters, digits and dashes.
errors.invalid_odometer: Enter the mileage as a whole number.
errors.odometer_lower_than_previous: This reading is lower than the previous one.
errors.work_order_closed: This order is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
errors.invalid_quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero, e.g. 1 or 1.5.
errors.invalid_currency: Currency must be a three-letter code like PLN.
errors.invalid_vehicle_role: Choose a vehicle type from the list.
errors.unknown_client: This client no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.owner_change_before_start: The date is before the current owner got the car.
errors.reading_belongs_to_work_order: This reading belongs to a work order. Change it there.
errors.invalid_part_number: Part number: up to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dashes, dots or slashes.
errors.invalid_unit: Choose a unit from the list.
errors.invalid_barcode: This code cannot be used. Scan it again.
errors.part_number_taken: A part with this brand and part number already exists.
errors.barcode_taken: This barcode already belongs to another part.
errors.part_in_use: This part is used in work orders and cannot be deleted.
errors.unknown_part: This part no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.cannot_reset_own_password: Change your own password on the account page.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.tax_id_taken: A supplier with this tax number already exists. Pick it from the list.
errors.invalid_tax_id: Check the tax number: letters and digits only, e.g. 1234567890.
errors.unknown_supplier: This supplier no longer exists. Pick another one.
errors.invoice_already_entered: This invoice of this supplier is already entered. Open the existing delivery instead.
errors.delivery_posted: The delivery is already on stock. Reopen it to change the lines.
errors.delivery_not_posted: The delivery is not on stock yet.
errors.delivery_empty: Add at least one line first.
errors.delivery_unmatched_lines: Some lines have no part yet. Choose or create a part for each of them.
errors.unsupported_file_type: Only PDF, XML (KSeF) and photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) can be attached.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large. The limit is 15 MB.
errors.too_many_files: A delivery can have at most 20 files.
errors.invalid_markup: Enter the markup as a whole number from 0 to 1000, or leave it empty.
errors.invalid_vat: Enter VAT as a whole number from 0 to 100, e.g. 23.
errors.invalid_time_zone: Your device reports an unknown time zone. Check its date settings.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.searchPlaceholder: Plate, VIN, frame no. or owner
vehicles.noResults: Nothing found. Check the spelling or add the vehicle.
vehicles.empty: No vehicles yet. Add the first one.
vehicles.identificationHint: Fill in at least one: plate, VIN or frame number.
vehicles.frameNumberHint: For Japanese cars without a VIN, e.g. GX100-1234567.
vehicles.changeOwnerHint: The current owner moves to the history. The car's service history stays with the car.
vehicles.removeOwner: Car has no known owner now

clients.name: Name
clients.editHint: Changes apply everywhere this client appears.

odometer.confirmLower: This reading is lower than the previous one. Save it anyway? (For example, the instrument cluster was replaced.)

workOrders.title: Work orders
workOrders.complaintHint: What the customer asked for, in their words.
workOrders.noneOpen: No cars in work right now.
workOrders.startHint: To open one, find the vehicle first.
workOrders.closedHint: This order is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
workOrders.confirmDeleteItem: Delete this line from the order?
workOrders.confirmCancel: Cancel this work order? It stays in the history as cancelled.

parts.title: Parts
parts.unknownBarcode: No part has this barcode yet:
parts.noResults: Nothing found. Check the spelling or add the part.
parts.empty: No parts yet. Add the first one.
parts.name: Name
parts.partNumberHint: OEM number or the maker's article, as printed on the box.
parts.minStockHint: Below this amount the part shows up under Low stock. 0: no minimum.
parts.sellPriceHint: Used by default when the part is added to a work order.
parts.barcodeHint: Scan it from the box, or leave empty if there is none.
parts.noBarcodes: No barcodes yet. Scan the box to add one.
parts.countHint: Enter how many are on the shelf now. The difference is recorded.
parts.confirmDelete: Delete this part and its stock history?
parts.countCostHint: Optional. Values the parts on the shelf; saved only when the count is higher than the stock.

labels.title: QR labels
labels.skipHint: On a partly used sheet: how many labels at the start are already gone.
labels.printHint: A4 sheet with 3 × 8 labels of 70 × 37 mm. In the print dialog choose scale 100% and no margins.
labels.noCode: This part has no QR code yet. Open the part and choose “Print QR label”.

settings.title: Business settings
settings.hint: Apply to everyone in this workshop.
settings.distanceUnitHint: Default for new vehicles. Each vehicle keeps the unit its odometer shows.
settings.confirmCurrency: Change the currency from {from} to {to}? Prices already entered are not converted: the same amounts will be shown in {to}.
settings.markupHint: Added to the net purchase price, then VAT, to suggest shelf prices when a delivery is posted. Leave empty for no suggestions.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.intro: Purchase invoices from suppliers. A delivery adds its parts to stock at the net purchase price once it is posted.
deliveries.searchPlaceholder: Supplier, invoice number or delivery number
deliveries.empty: No deliveries yet. Enter the first invoice.
deliveries.draftHint: Draft: nothing is on stock until you post it.
deliveries.invoiceTotalHint: Optional: the lines are checked against it.
deliveries.unmatchedHint: Without a part the line is kept as written on the invoice. Choose a part before posting.
deliveries.totalMismatch: The invoice says {invoice} net, the lines add up to {lines}. Check the lines.
deliveries.filesHint: Attach the invoice: PDF, XML from KSeF or a photo of the paper copy. Up to 15 MB each.
deliveries.postBlocked: Choose a part for every line to post the delivery.
deliveries.postHint: All lines go on stock at their net price. Tick the parts whose shelf price should change.
deliveries.noMarkup: Set a markup to get suggested prices.
deliveries.confirmReopen: Reopen this delivery? Its parts are taken off stock until you post it again.
deliveries.confirmDelete: Delete this draft with its lines and files?

stockCount.title: Stock count
stockCount.intro: Go shelf by shelf: scan or find a part, enter how many are really there, save, take the next one. The difference is recorded.

report.title: Stock report
report.intro: What was bought, what went into work orders and what is left on the shelves.
report.yearUsedSale: Used in {year}, at work order prices

warnUnpricedReceipts.one: {count} delivery line has no purchase price.
warnUnpricedReceipts.other: {count} delivery lines have no purchase price.

warnUnpricedLines.one: {count} part in work orders has no price.
warnUnpricedLines.other: {count} parts in work orders have no price.

warnUnvaluedLines.one: {count} used part has no purchase price.
warnUnvaluedLines.other: {count} used parts have no purchase price.

warnUnvaluedParts.one: {count} part on stock has no purchase price: its value is missing.
warnUnvaluedParts.other: {count} parts on stock have no purchase price: their value is missing.

warnNegativeParts.one: {count} part is below zero: its delivery was probably not entered.
warnNegativeParts.other: {count} parts are below zero: their deliveries were probably not entered.

report.stockOn: Stock value at the end of {date}:
report.howNet: Purchases are net prices from the deliveries, by invoice date.
report.howValue: Stock is valued at the last known net purchase price of each part.
report.howSale: Work order prices are as entered in the orders.
report.howCount: Parts found during a stock count are not purchases: they only add to the stock value.
